units.characteristics: appetite / self-control; deceptive food
units.gist: 'put a knife to your throat if you are given to appetite'; the stingy host 'inwardly calculating' - 'Eat! he says, but his heart is not with you'; wealth that flies away

units.characteristics: the heart directed / applied / given
units.gist: CORNERSTONE - 'apply your heart to instruction'; 'direct your heart in the way'; 'my son, GIVE ME YOUR HEART, and let your eyes observe my ways' - the heart as the thing offered

units.characteristics: the parental inmost joy at a child's wisdom
units.gist: 'if your heart is wise, my heart too will be glad; my INMOST BEING will exult when your lips speak what is right' (relational inner joy)

units.characteristics: the heart guarded from envy; continuing in the fear of the LORD
units.gist: 'let not your heart envy sinners, but continue in the fear of the LORD all the day... your hope will not be cut off' (envy vs fear + hope)

units.characteristics: the enslaved appetite - addiction
units.gist: the drunkard - 'your heart will utter perverse things'; the addiction cycle 'when shall I awake? I must have another drink' (the will captured by appetite)

units.characteristics: resilience under adversity
units.gist: GEM - 'if you faint in the day of adversity, your strength is small' (the tested inner strength)

units.characteristics: God weighs the heart / knows the excuse
units.gist: CORNERSTONE - 'does not he who WEIGHS THE HEART perceive it? does not he who keeps watch over your soul know it?' - the pretended-ignorance seen through (w/ Ps 139)

units.characteristics: the righteous rises again
units.gist: GEM - 'the righteous falls seven times and rises again, but the wicked stumble in calamity' (resilience)

units.characteristics: the heart guarded against gloating; not repaying
units.gist: 'do not rejoice when your enemy falls, let not your heart be glad'; 'fret not because of evildoers'; 'do not say, I will do to him as he has done to me' (the disposition toward the enemy, w/ Ps 37, 20:22)

units.characteristics: wisdom sweet to the soul; hope
units.gist: 'wisdom is [honey] to your soul; if you find it, there is a future, and your hope will not be cut off'

units.characteristics: the unsearchable depth of the heart
units.gist: 'as the heavens for height and the earth for depth, so the heart of kings is unsearchable' (the heart's depth, w/ 20:5)

units.characteristics: the heavy heart mis-comforted
units.gist: GEM - 'whoever sings songs to a heavy heart is like vinegar on soda' (the felt heavy heart; comfort mistimed wounds)

units.characteristics: good done to the enemy
units.gist: CORNERSTONE - 'if your enemy is hungry, give him bread... you will heap burning coals on his head, and the LORD will reward you' (love of enemy, w/ Rom 12:20)

units.characteristics: the thirsting soul refreshed by good news
units.gist: 'like cold water to a thirsty soul, so is good news from a far country' (the soul's thirst, w/ Ps 42/63)

units.characteristics: self-control as the wall of the self
units.gist: CORNERSTONE - 'a man without self-control is like a city broken into and left without walls' (the un-ruled self defenceless, w/ 16:32, 29:11)

units.characteristics: self-conceit worse than folly
units.gist: GEM - 'do you see a man wise in his own eyes? there is more hope for a fool than for him' (self-conceit, w/ 3:7)

units.characteristics: sloth (the sluggard's self-excusing)
units.gist: the comic sluggard - 'a lion in the road!'; turning on his bed like a door on hinges; 'wiser in his own eyes than seven men' (self-justifying inertia)

units.characteristics: speech masking the heart; concealed hatred
units.gist: CORNERSTONE - 'fervent lips with an evil heart [are like] glaze on a vessel'; 'whoever hates disguises himself with his lips and harbors deceit... seven abominations in his heart'; the covered hatred exposed (the discrepancy speech/heart)

units.characteristics: presumption about tomorrow; self-praise
units.gist: 'do not boast about tomorrow, for you do not know what a day may bring'; 'let another praise you, not your own mouth' (presumption + self-glory, w/ Ps 30:6)

units.characteristics: the strength of the passions (jealousy)
units.gist: GEM - 'wrath is cruel, anger is overwhelming, but who can stand before jealousy?' (the ranking of the passions)

units.characteristics: the honest friend; open rebuke vs hidden love
units.gist: 'better open rebuke than hidden love'; 'FAITHFUL are the wounds of a friend, profuse the kisses of an enemy'; 'oil and perfume make the heart glad, and the sweetness of a friend from earnest counsel'

units.characteristics: formation by company
units.gist: CORNERSTONE - 'iron sharpens iron, and one man sharpens another' (the self shaped by another, w/ 13:20)

units.characteristics: the heart as the true self
units.gist: CORNERSTONE - 'as in water face reflects face, so the heart of man reflects the man' (the heart = the real self)

units.characteristics: the insatiable eye/desire
units.gist: CORNERSTONE - 'Sheol and Abaddon are never satisfied, and never satisfied are the eyes of man' (the unfillable appetite, w/ Ecc)

units.characteristics: a man tested by his praise
units.gist: 'the crucible for silver... and a man is tested by his praise' (how one bears praise reveals the self)

units.characteristics: conscience - the wicked flee, the righteous bold
units.gist: GEM - 'the wicked flee when no one pursues, but the righteous are bold as a lion' (the inner state of guilt vs clear conscience)

units.characteristics: confession vs concealment of sin
units.gist: CORNERSTONE - 'whoever conceals his transgressions will not prosper, but he who confesses and forsakes them will obtain mercy' (w/ Ps 32)

units.characteristics: fearing always vs hardening the heart
units.gist: 'blessed is the one who fears the LORD always, but whoever hardens his heart will fall into calamity' (fear vs the hardened heart)

units.characteristics: trust in the LORD vs greed / self-reliance
units.gist: CORNERSTONE - 'a greedy man stirs up strife, but the one who TRUSTS in the LORD will be enriched'; 'whoever trusts in his own mind is a fool, but he who walks in wisdom will be delivered' (w/ 3:5)

units.characteristics: the unteachable hardened self
units.gist: GEM - 'he who is often reproved, yet stiffens his neck, will suddenly be broken beyond healing' (the hardened, unteachable heart)

units.characteristics: self-restraint - venting vs holding back the spirit
units.gist: CORNERSTONE - 'a fool gives full vent to his spirit, but a wise man quietly holds it back' (the mastered spirit, w/ 16:32, 25:28)

units.characteristics: pride brings low; the lowly in spirit honoured
units.gist: CORNERSTONE - 'one's pride will bring him low, but he who is lowly in spirit will obtain honour' (pride/humility, w/ 11:2, 15:33, 18:12)

units.characteristics: the fear of man vs trust in the LORD
units.gist: CORNERSTONE - 'the fear of man lays a snare, but whoever trusts in the LORD is safe' (fear-of-man vs trust, w/ Ps 56:11, 118:6)

units.characteristics: the man of wrath stirs strife
units.gist: 'a man of wrath stirs up strife, and one given to anger causes much transgression' (anger thread)
